text:
Create one stylized base identity portrait of {{CHARACTER_NAME}}.

Role of each input:
{{REFERENCE_LIST}}

The identity reference defines this person: age, facial structure, hair, and other stable traits. Preserve that person.

The style anchor controls only the rendering language. Do not transfer the style anchor's facial geometry, hair, moustache, age, clothing, or identity onto this person.

{{STYLE_LANGUAGE}}

Framing: chest-up portrait, mouth visible, plain background, no extra people.
Target aspect ratio: {{ASPECT_RATIO}}.
No text, logo, or watermark.
